youtube.summary: Paul Brennan talks with Joel Robinson about the recent wave of short liquidations driving Bitcoin's surge past $72,000, the strategies behind corporate Bitcoin buyers like Strive, and rising bond yields exposing strain in the US financial system. They also cover ACT's newly proposed digital asset policy, including a capital gains exemption for long-term holders and a $10,000 de minimis for everyday crypto payments. youtube.summary: "So, the best I can offer you is two to three months of your life." - Ross Collett, Retired Insurance Broker Rodney Hide speaks with Ross Collett, who was diagnosed with terminal pancreatic cancer and given just 2–3 months to live. youtube.summary: On Both Barrels this week, Rachel Stewart and Maree Buscke discuss their experiences with a particularly severe flu season, describing how seriously ill they became and suggesting it may be the worst flu season since 2016.
